name: Content testimonials
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Content testimonials. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Layout style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Number of testimonials
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust number of testimonials. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.
